tianxia.talent.talismans.ember_talisman.label: Ember Talisman
tianxia.talent.talismans.ember_talisman.why: Printed target: one creature or object. An object delivery rolls the Talisman Attack against its AC, deals the same CL-scaled fire dice on a hit, and consumes one talisman. Activation and stored crafting bonuses use the ordinary hooks.

insight.hidden-sleeve-adept.why: talismans.limit adds one prepared capacity for this owned Insight. talisman_preparation records starting preparation and the optional one-talisman readying at Initiative without an Action, capped at that limit. Ability-score selection belongs to character building.

tianxia.talent.talismans.formula_library.why: talisman_preparation records the last long-rest family and benefit. Combat applies one family-restricted prepared slot or Read the Script Advantage against established writing of that family. Crafting DC/CP reductions remain outside this fight.
